android.desc:
🎣 Fishing & Idle Game Experience!
Discover the thrill of fishing and progress with every tap! 🐟 With idle game mechanics, tap the screen to catch fish and upgrade your skills to increase fishing speed. Every click contributes to your in-game progress and collection.

🌊 Visual Delight & Lakeside Scenery
Each chapter features unique lake scenery and stunning pixel art graphics. With 10 distinct chapters, each offers its own atmosphere and rich content. Explore the beauty of lakesides while expanding your fish collection. 🐠

🏆 Dive to the Top of the Leaderboard!
Are you ready to compete with the best fishers of the day, week, and all time? Collect seashells to climb the ranks, prove your skills, and become the ultimate fisher! Each shell brings you closer to the top, and keeping your spot on the leaderboard has never been this exciting. Leave your friends behind and make your name legendary in the ocean!

🏆 Legendary Fish & Rare Seashells
Catch legendary fish and collect rare seashells to complete your collection. These rare items boost your fishing speed and accelerate your progress. Each chapter offers different rewards and strategies. 🐡

⚡ Fast Progress with Idle Clicker Mechanics
Upgrade your skills, complete your collection, and make strategic decisions for maximum efficiency. Each level and chapter includes challenges and bonuses that deepen the gameplay.

✨ Key Features:
• Continuous gains with idle mechanics
• Upgrade skills to boost fishing speed
• Collect rare seashells & legendary fish
• 10 unique, rich chapters
• Stunning pixel art & lakeside scenery
• Gameplay combining strategy & fun
• Endless exploration and progression

🌐 Supported in 7 languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish

🎯 Perfect for fishing and collection enthusiasts!
Download now, catch legendary fish, collect seashells, and become the fastest fisher at the lake! 🌊🐟✨

quotes.text:
Hey everyone!

I just released my new Android idle game called Idle Fishing. 
You can catch fish, upgrade your boat, and enjoy a relaxing experience by the sea.

I made all the pixel art myself and built everything from scratch using LibGDX.

Would love to hear your thoughts and feedback — especially from other indie devs!

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nervousibexgames.idlefishingsimulator

Thanks for checking it out
